# Zil-e-Huma Suleman — Clinical Psychologist

> Zil-e-Huma Suleman is a Clinical Psychologist based in Islamabad, Pakistan, specializing in evidence-based therapy, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), clinical hypnotherapy, and online counseling. She provides compassionate, confidential mental healthcare for anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, and personal growth.

## Services

- [Individual Therapy](https://zilehuma.online/services/individual-therapy): Personalized one-on-one therapy sessions for anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, relationship challenges, self-esteem, and personal growth.
- [Anxiety & Stress Management](https://zilehuma.online/services/anxiety-stress-management): Evidence-based CBT techniques, mindfulness, and graded exposure therapy for generalized anxiety, social anxiety, panic attacks, workplace burnout, and academic pressure.
- [Hypnotherapy Sessions](https://zilehuma.online/services/hypnotherapy-sessions): Clinical hypnotherapy for deep healing, habit change, phobias, emotional blocks, chronic pain management, and behavioral transformation.
- [Behavioral Therapy (CBT)](https://zilehuma.online/services/behavioral-therapy): Structured Cognitive Behavioral Therapy to reshape negative thought patterns, treat depression, OCD, PTSD, and build healthier behaviors.
- [Psychological Assessments](https://zilehuma.online/services/psychological-assessments): Comprehensive diagnostic evaluations using standardized psychometric instruments for accurate diagnosis and personalized treatment planning.
- [Online Counseling](https://zilehuma.online/services/online-counseling): Secure, encrypted video therapy sessions accessible from anywhere in Pakistan or abroad, available in Urdu and English.
